application:quit.effect: Saves working-diagram state and asks the main process to quit the whole application.
application:quit.note: Main process closes every window; a window with unsaved changes raises a blocking native Save/Don't Save/Cancel box (window.js close handler). Choosing Save routes to project:save, which opens a native save dialog for an untitled project. Terminates the app, which also stops any in-app server.

application:reload.effect: Asks the main process to relaunch the application and then quits it (full app restart, not a window reload).
application:reload.note: Kills every window and with it the in-app HTTP server; it does not come back until the relaunched app finishes loading. Shares application:quit's path, so a modified project raises the blocking native Save/Don't Save/Cancel box (window close handler) before the quit proceeds.

edit:copy.effect: Copies the selected model (single) or selected copyable views to the StarUML clipboard; inside a text field forwards a native copy.

edit:cut.effect: Copies then deletes the selected model or views (text-field focus: native cut).
edit:cut.note: View cut goes through edit:delete, which can open the 'Delete Views Only / Delete from Model' modal when the diagram allows neither deleting nor hiding views.

edit:delete.effect: Deletes the selected views from the diagram (or hides them where the diagram only allows hiding); models stay.
edit:delete.note: If the current diagram can neither delete nor hide views (e.g. lifelines in sequence diagrams), opens a renderer modal asking Delete Views Only / Delete from Model / Cancel.

edit:delete-from-model.effect: Deletes the selected models (and models of selected views) from the repository, closing any deleted diagrams; no confirmation.
edit:delete-from-model.note: Destructive without prompt; undoable via edit:undo.

edit:move-down.effect: Moves the selected element one position down within its parent's collection.

edit:move-up.effect: Moves the selected element one position up within its parent's collection.

edit:open-sub-diagram.effect: Opens the first diagram owned by the selected element (or its sub-activity/sub-machine); toast if none.

edit:paste.effect: Pastes the clipboard model under the selected element or clipboard views into the current diagram (text-field focus: native paste).
edit:paste.note: Shows a blocking native info box when clipboard views cannot be pasted into the current diagram.

edit:redo.effect: Redoes the last undone operation (text-field focus: native redo).

edit:select-all.effect: Selects all views in the current diagram, or all text in a focused input.

edit:select-in-diagram.effect: Selects a view of the selected model in a diagram, opening that diagram.
edit:select-in-diagram.note: If the model has views in more than one diagram, opens an element-list picker modal to choose the diagram; toast if none.

edit:select-in-explorer.effect: Reveals and selects the first selected model in the Model Explorer.

edit:undo.effect: Undoes the last operation (text-field focus: native undo).

project:open.effect: Opens a .mdj project: loads it in this window if the window is empty and unmodified, otherwise asks the main process to open it in a new window.

args.name: path
args.note: Menu items pass the recent-file path as command-arg.

project:open-recent.effect: Opens a recently used project via project:open, or drops it from the recent list with an error toast if the file no longer exists.
project:open-recent.note: Delegates to project:open with a path, which opens in this window when empty/unmodified, otherwise in a new window; only a load failure shows an error box. Missing/omitted path just toasts. The project:open promise is not returned.

project:print-to-pdf.effect: Opens the Print modal, then a save dialog, and writes the chosen diagrams to a PDF.

project:save-as.effect: Asks for a new file name with a native save dialog and saves the project there.
project:save-as.note: Path and save-as flag are pre-bound, so caller arguments cannot bypass the dialog.

uml:create-model-and-view.frame.effect: Asks which model element the frame represents, then draws a frame for it on the diagram.
uml:create-model-and-view.frame.note: Element picker dialog every time; nothing is created on cancel.

uml:create-model.constraint.effect: Creates a constraint under the selected element; for operations, behaviors and actions asks which constraint slot (pre/post/body etc.) to use.
uml:create-model.constraint.note: Radio dialog only when the selection is a UMLOperation, UMLBehavior or UMLAction; otherwise it creates a plain owned constraint silently.

uml:create-model.do-activity.effect: Asks for a behavior kind and creates it in the selected state's doActivities.
uml:create-model.do-activity.note: Always opens a radio dialog to choose OpaqueBehavior/Activity/StateMachine/Interaction.

uml:create-model.effect.effect: Asks for a behavior kind and creates it as an effect of the selected transition.
uml:create-model.effect.note: Always opens a radio dialog to choose OpaqueBehavior/Activity/StateMachine/Interaction.

uml:create-model.entry-activity.effect: Asks for a behavior kind and creates it in the selected state's entryActivities.
uml:create-model.entry-activity.note: Always opens a radio dialog to choose OpaqueBehavior/Activity/StateMachine/Interaction.

uml:create-model.exit-activity.effect: Asks for a behavior kind and creates it in the selected state's exitActivities.
uml:create-model.exit-activity.note: Always opens a radio dialog to choose OpaqueBehavior/Activity/StateMachine/Interaction.

view:actual-size.effect: Resets diagram zoom to 100%, keeping the view centre.

view:close-other-diagrams.effect: Closes all diagram tabs except the current one.

view:editors.effect: Shows or hides the right-hand Editors panel (property/style/documentation editors).

view:fit-to-window.effect: Zooms (max 100%) and scrolls so the whole current diagram fits the viewport.

view:navigator.effect: Shows or hides the Navigator panel.

view:next-diagram.effect: Switches to the next open diagram tab.

view:previous-diagram.effect: Switches to the previous open diagram tab.

view:quick-find.effect: Opens the Quick Find modal for searching elements by name.

view:rename-diagram.effect: Opens a text-input modal to rename the current diagram.
view:rename-diagram.note: Throws if there is no current diagram.

view:show-grid.effect: Toggles grid visibility in the diagram editor.

view:snap-to-grid.effect: Toggles snap-to-grid in the diagram editor.

view:statusbar.effect: Shows or hides the status bar.

view:zoom-in.effect: Increases diagram zoom by 10%, keeping the view centre.

view:zoom-out.effect: Decreases diagram zoom by 10%, keeping the view centre.
